Priya Shah: Customer (FinServ X) says procurement is blocked until we clarify rollback story for sealed on‑prem bundles. Questions: what triggers a rollback, how are bundles signed/verified, can we do hotfixes without full reinstall?
Alex Nguyen: Quick answer: signed tarball + manifest. Rollback triggers: failed post‑install healthcheck, license validation fail, model binary mismatch. We support delta hotfixes via chunked patches but that needs the sidecar/patcher preinstalled in airgapped sites.
Mateo Lopez: Implementation notes: healthcheck = systemd unit + model load probe. If probe fails, operator marks node degraded and will attempt auto‑rollback to previous bundle (configurable window). Auto‑rollback requires offline admin token in sealed envs (safety). Example CLI for manual rollback:
```
kubectl -n redwood exec deploy/operator -- rollback --to v1.4.2
```
Sam Carter: Commercial: does unattended rollback change SLA? Customer asking if we can guarantee recovery without on‑site tech and wants 99.9% for the POC.
Claire Bennett: Legal: unattended changes in an air‑gapped customer environment need explicit change control in SOW. We can offer an SLA addendum for Dedicated/Managed but Private installs require signoff and an agreed rollback policy.
Alex Nguyen: Packaging cadence options: (1) monthly stable bundles, (2) quarterly LTS. For POC we recommend monthly + a one‑off hotfix channel. Hotfix flow: deliver signed delta file -> operator verifies signature & checksum -> apply. If verification fails operator aborts and records event id.
Priya Shah: Pricing ask from customer: can we include 2 weeks of free hotfix support and discounted emergency patches? This affects the commercial take.
Sam Carter: I can propose 2‑week complimentary POC support + 50% off emergency patch labor for first 3 months, pending finance approval.
deploy-bot: CI: built signed-bundle v1.5.0‑poc sha256:abcd1234; staged at /artifacts/sealed/1758234567
Mateo Lopez: Followups for SOC: we need to produce a manual rollback runbook (operator CLI steps + USB thumbdrive signature verification + offline token exchange). I'll draft it and share by EOD tomorrow.
Priya Shah: Great — I'll respond to the customer with the runbook ETA and request SOC call. @Sam Carter please loop finance and @Claire Bennett for SOW language. :thumbsup:
Sam Carter: On it, cc'ing Claire for SOW.
